hook: Your map of Mumbai hides seven separate islands.
title: Mumbai Was Seven Islands, Not One City
description:
Mumbai was once a group of seven separate islands. Land reclamation slowly joined them into the single city on the coast. Colaba, Mazagaon, Worli, Mahim and Parel are among the old island names. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Mumbai #Geography
